headline: Papelera del Sur Closes Factory in Argentina
summary: Papelera del Sur is closing its factory in Tornquist, Argentina, resulting in the loss of approximately 160 jobs. The company cited a lack of profitability and the inability to compete with imported products.
why: The closure highlights the ongoing challenges faced by local manufacturing industries in Argentina due to competitive pressures and economic conditions.

impacts.name: Papelera del Sur
impacts.why: Factory closure signifies the end of operations for the entity in that location.
